summary: Hood River County, OR lookout built by the USFS in 1930 and now gone; the summit is a trail-reached viewpoint in the Mark O. Hatfield Wilderness.

facts.status_note: Both listings say it is gone; neither gives a year for its removal

access.note: Summit reached on foot by trail in the Mark O. Hatfield Wilderness; the field guide mentions no closure

visit.trail_note: Reached on foot. The Gorton Creek Trail passes nearly directly over the summit; the field guide puts the summit 9.6 miles on foot from Herman Creek Trailhead.

events.note: Built by the USFS in 1930 (FFLOS). firelookout.com separately lists a 1930 entry, marked gone.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The FFLOS register gives 4,730 ft (1,442 m); the Oregon Hikers field guide gives 4,737 ft. The register value is kept and the story notes both.

sources.title: Green Point Mountain - Oregon Hikers Field Guide

notes_for_editor: Thin record: two listings and a field guide. One web search and one page read found no staffing or fire history for this summit. Search results for Green Point also returned a different lookout (Lincoln County Green Point near Neskowin, firetower green-point-lookout-site, and oregonlookouts.weebly.com/green-point.html); those were not used. No photos added. Record coordinates match the FFLOS register. Fact-check 2026-10-09: the field guide text was searched for closure, closed and closing; none found, so 'no closure mentioned' stands.
